prompt.text:
Implement a new deterministic text analyzer with this exact API:

export type DocumentKind = "note" | "dialogue"
export interface TextDigest { summary: string; labels: string[] }
export function digestText(text: string, kind: DocumentKind): TextDigest

Normalize CRLF to LF and trim each line. Empty or whitespace-only text returns an empty summary and labels. For a note, summary units are nonempty sentences split at '.', '!' or '?'. For a dialogue, summary units are nonempty lines after removing an optional leading speaker prefix ending in ':'. The summary is the first two units, joined by one space; preserve their original case.

Labels are extracted case-insensitively and returned as unique lowercase strings in ascending code-unit order. Notes use hashtags matching '#' followed by one or more ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Dialogues use markers of the form '[skill: value]', where value is trimmed and must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Malformed or empty markers are ignored. Throw RangeError for a kind other than the two declared values at runtime. Do not mutate or alias caller-owned data.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
